import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest import mock

from django.utils import autoreload

# Simulate running `python -m foo.bar.baz runserver`
class FakeSpec(SimpleNamespace):
    pass

# Case 1: module (foo.bar.baz)
fake_spec_module = FakeSpec(name='foo.bar.baz', parent='foo.bar')
fake_main_module = SimpleNamespace(__spec__=fake_spec_module)
with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {'__main__': fake_main_module}):
    with mock.patch('sys.argv', ['baz.py', 'runserver']):
        with mock.patch('sys.warnoptions', []):
            print('Module case:', autoreload.get_child_arguments())

# Case 2: package (foo.bar.__main__)
fake_spec_pkg = FakeSpec(name='foo.bar.__main__', parent='foo.bar')
fake_main_pkg = SimpleNamespace(__spec__=fake_spec_pkg)
with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {'__main__': fake_main_pkg}):
    with mock.patch('sys.argv', ['__main__.py', 'runserver']):
        with mock.patch('sys.warnoptions', []):
            print('Package case:', autoreload.get_child_arguments())
